utterances.text: "I put a yellow line and number 1. "Mrs. Kundo, can you now show me, stand where you were located, to the best of your recollection, at the time that you were shot? "I will now mark that spot using yellow spray paint. "I marked it with a yellow X with a number 1 beside it. "Mrs. Kundo, can you face in the direction that you were facing and assume the position that you were, as close as you can, if you can recall, at the time that you were shot. "And finally, can you please indicate from which direction you heard the gun-shot, as closely as you can recall, at the time that you were shot."

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Just for the record, Mrs. Kundo showed in this video-clip that the shot came from the left; correct?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, from down the hill, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: She confirmed that she was moving from her house to the other side of the street. Is this the direction she claimed she was moving in, the one we see on this video?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. This video should be viewed in -- in light of her eventual testimony at the trial. There is some comment during her testimony about this video.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Is she correctly positioned in this video relative to the direction of movement or not?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, she's not.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did she tell you where the source of water was relative to the direction she was moving in? Behind her or ahead of her?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. As -- as we're looking to this photo, to our left is her residence and to our right is a -- a hill at the bottom of which is a spring or a stream. And when she was shot, she was coming back up the hill and crossing the street, carrying full pales of water towards her house. So in this picture, she is 180 degrees opposite to what she had said before and subsequently.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did she tell you, or did you find out, how far the confrontation line was from this place?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did, and I don't recall what it is right now. And -- and, again, with the assistance of the sniping expert.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let me ask you something briefly about the incident F9.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Video from this incident is in our evidence, I think, so there is no need for us to enter this one into evidence, since we quoted exact time-periods we watched now.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I -- I couldn't tell you from the top of my head whether it is or not. But let's verify this and I take it that if it's not in evidence there will be no objection.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I'm getting the signs that actually the whole video is not.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Also, off the top of my head, my recollection is that this video with Mrs. Kundo is not in evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Then we would offer this part to -- into the evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Therefore, it needed to be uploaded in e-court with sound, et cetera. I don't know whether Madam Registrar has sufficient material to admit into -- or to register as admitted into evidence the video, inclusive of sound.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: I have received a CD but I cannot confirm exactly what is on the CD.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then it seems that there will be no disagreement, I take it, among the parties what was shown and then -- yes, Ms. Hochhauser.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I can tell you that we provided this CD to the Registry under 22311F. It would be the entirety of this interview, not specifically what he showed but it would include that. That would be the 65 ter number.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. You want to have it in evidence. You do not object. The best technical way of having it into evidence is still to be decided, but we reserve a number at this moment. Madam Registrar, the number reserved for the portion we just looked at would be ...

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Reserve number would be D381, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The technicalities for how it will be recorded as evidence are still to be worked out, together with Madam Registrar, whether we take the portion of the Sanction or whether we take something that was uploaded by the Defence under a D number, but where sound apparently could not be produced.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I would just add to that that I don't have an objection to this coming in, but I think appropriately it should come in with the additional testimonial material that the witness referenced, so I would be -- unless counsel is ready to agree to that now, I'll be submitting an additional 92 bis application for her Galic testimony beginning at approximately transcript 5943 to 5950.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I would suggest that the parties try to seek an agreement on the total package video and related testimony in another case.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: In addition, we should put on the record that we saw this video from 2 hours 39 minutes to 2 hours 41 minutes and 24 seconds, because the counting was different in the two versions.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I'm additionally informed by Ms. Stewart that the portion of the video that's under that 65 ter number begins in the same place but has approximately six additional minutes of video passed where Mr. Lukic showed in court.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. And if you want to have that added, that may be part of the package. I really urge the parties to sit together and to see what the Chamber should receive in evidence on this incident.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: And what do we mark as D381?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We reserved a number, I think.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We received a number and whether we need further numbers later, depending on what the package deal would be, we do not know yet. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Please proceed, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Now I should like to focus on incident F9, wherein 16-year-old Sanela Muratovic was injured. We need again P3, page 21. You recall this. It was said here that the girl, Sanela Muratovic, was injured, and it is said here that it was from the school for the blind. I would like to ask you: During your investigation, did you learn that the upper floor of the school for the blind, on the 26th of June, 1994, when this incident occurred was almost completely devastated and there was no cover there at all?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I did not learn that. In fact, I learned the opposite. It was -- it was not without cover there.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: How many confrontation lines with the presence of the Army of Bosnia-Herzegovina were there and how distant were they from this place?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I am not sure what you're asking me. I know the confrontation line between this location where I'm standing in this photo and the school for the blind, but I'm not sure about how many confrontation lines you're talking. That's confusing to me.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Is it the case that this girl is standing in a place where there was a trench of the BH army with soldiers in that trench?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, there was a trench that crossed this road. I was told it was built by civil defence to help civilians cross safely. But there were no soldiers in this trench, no.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: How do you know that, that there were no troops in the trench?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: The witnesses told me.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Mr. Hogan, I should like us to focus now on the incident that occurred on 18 November 1994 - that's F12 - where it is said that Dzenana Sokolovic, 31, and her son, Nermin Divovic, were shot while walking along the street.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we see 65 ter 1D1301.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you remember and do you agree that the place shown by Dzenana Sokolovic as the place where she was shot was close to the land museum in Sarajevo?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, we're in the parking lot of the museum in Sarajevo.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I know you have been asked this in other trials, but for certain verifications, we need to know how tall you are. Is it true that you are 193 centimetres tall?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did you find out, did you ask Dzenana Sokolovic how tall she was?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. I should like to move now to the football match in Dobrinja. That's the incident of 18 November 1994.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Before we do so, Mr. Lukic, I'm a bit lost about how tall Mr. Hogan is, what the -- what the relevance of that is. If you tell us briefly, then at least we are perhaps better able to remember what was said.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes. This lady was wounded at the same time when her son was killed.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And it would be important for us to know his height and her height, to be able to establish from which point her son was killed, since we know that she was wounded in the hip, and he was wounded into the head, and it depends of the elevation of the shooting point.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: [Microphone not activated]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Your Honour, I didn't hear you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I'm just asking what has that got to do with the height of the witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Then we can establish the height of the lady standing beside him.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: How do you establish that by establishing his --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I think it is possible.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, whether or not it's possible, if people are standing at a different distance from the camera is still to be seen. But at least that's what you -- you've explained to us why you needed this information at this moment. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We can -- briefly we can see video where they stand at the same distance from camera. It's V000-6997.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: They're standing here at an equal distance from the camera?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Maybe the lady is a bit closer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. That's what I mean.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yeah. But still I think it's possible to establish the height.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Actually, if I could just ask for clarification. Mr. Lukic just said we were turning to an incident on 18 November 1994?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. I think I stopped him, more or less, and asked him and he was about to move on. And the incident, 18 November, would be, Mr. Lukic, the next one, therefore?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: No, this was 18 November incident.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And I would now move to soccer game in Dobrinja. It's G incident; it's shelling. I think it's G4. Yes, it is G4.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In September 2001, you were at Dobrinja in the place where the incident of the football match occurred on the 1st of June, 1993. Do you remember that?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let us see one photograph that was taken from your video. That is your 3D picture. We shall need D175. At that time, it was MFI'd. Would you agree -- in fact, first of all, tell us, in your view and according to the witnesses who explained this to you, where, in which place, did the incident occur on this upper slab which is the pitch, or the lower ground, which is the parking lot?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the parking lot, where the camera is located taking this photo.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Is it correct that both areas are shielded on three sides by these eight-storey apartment buildings and that on the fourth side there is the Mojmilo hill?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you agree with me when I say that this area was not visible from the positions of the RS? I mean the pitch and the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: You will therefore agree, won't you, that since this area was not visible, the VRS was unable to target it with infantry weapons, that is, rifles and machine-guns?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Judge, I object to this question.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. On the basis of?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: On the basis of it's outside of this witness's area of expertise as we've established numerous times.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I asked only because of the next question I have. If the witness noticed when he was investigating the site any bullet-holes on the walls of these buildings.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: What is now the question?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Well, sir, did you notice bullet-holes on those walls of these buildings when you investigated this site?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't recall seeing any. I'm not saying there weren't any, but I was focussed on filming the shelling location, not looking for bullet-holes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: It's a break time, actually. I was just warned -- warned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Could you tell us how much time you would still need after the break, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Half an hour, 45 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Well, let's then really try to -- to finish in half an hour, 45 minutes, and try to be as organised as possible. Could the witness be escorted out of the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We take a break, and we'll resume at quarter past 12.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: While the witness is brought in, I'd briefly deliver a decision on Witness RM247. The Prosecution this morning withdrew Witness RM247, and the Chamber hereby vacates it's admission decision in relation to all material admitted through the witness. And I briefly refer to it. It is an ICTY statement of the witness dated 26th of November, 2005. It is excerpts of the testimony of the witness, testimony of the witness in the Popovic case and two photographs, each marked by the witness, both photographs depicting the Orahovac school. That's hereby on the record.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Hogan, we'll now continue with the cross-examination. Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Hogan, we'll continue dealing with the soccer match incident at Dobrinja, the G4 incident. Is it correct that you photographed Mr. Ismet Haslic [as interpreted] who, according to his own words, was the referee at that match?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yeah, I think his last name was Faslic, but he was the referee, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [In English] Maybe I misspoke but I have Faslic here written as well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Let us now look at Exhibit 1D1312, document 1D1312, with the assistance of my colleague, Mr. Ivetic. Go. [In English] We tried to solve the problem over the break with the sound, but obviously we'll have to ask Ms. Stewart to play it from Sanction. It's V000-34971A, and we need from 1 minute, 55 seconds, to 2 minutes, 55 seconds. Can we start now, please. I think that's the start -- the starting point. Yes, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: "Could you please show me by standing in the spot where one of the posts, goal-posts, was located on the 1st of June, 1993. "Could you now please show me by standing on the spot where the second goal post at this end of the parking lot was located on the 1st of June, 1993, to the best of your recollection."

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: The size of the goal that Mr. Faslic indicated is over 3 metres; right?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I -- it would probably be approximately be 3 metres. I don't know if it's over 3 metres. It's a rough guesstimate just based on his strides.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we ask for this part of the video to be admitted into evidence, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: It is played from Sanction. Madam Registrar, is there any technical problem in admission?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: I will check if on the DVD provided to me is the actual portion. If not, we can replace it but ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then we reserve a number for this portion of the video played. The number reserved is ...

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: D382, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And we'll later hear from Madam Registrar whether the technical problems have been overcome and what exactly are the numbers which are now part of the body of evidence. You may proceed, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Next video I would like to show you, Mr. Hogan, is 1D1313, and since our system does not work, I would again kindly ask -- oh, this one does not have sound anyways, so we can see it from our screen. The time would be very short, from 2 hours, 8 minute, 20 seconds, to 2 hour, 8 minutes, 26 seconds. So only six seconds we'll see from this video.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we start now, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you recognise the same car park or any other area, because this was shown on BH TV as the incident site? And you will notice that in this still we see a small goal that is not larger -- rather, wider than 1 metre.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I recognise this video, and I did notice the -- the goal at that end of the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Just for my own clarity when we talk of goal, do we talk of a goal post.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's -- the one that I see in this video is more similar to a hockey net or a handball net, Your Honour. It's not a traditional soccer -- soccer goal or net.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: I understand what a goal is. That is a ball going through.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Not as a soccer player.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: You're talking of a post, some post of sorts, some pillar, some pole.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, and the cross bar and the net in behind the post, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: Right, okay. Thank you so much.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did Ismet Faslic show you that there were old cars along the sides of the pitch?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, he did. He indicated that they were there to sort of mark an out of bounds, or the boundary of the playing -- playing surface.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we -- we would like to tender this video into the evidence as well.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I just wonder -- unless I missed it, I didn't hear when this video was taken or alleged to have been taken or -- yeah, or where it's from.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: It's -- it's broadcasted on Bosnian TV in connection with this incident and was allegedly taped on the same day. And it's broadcasted on the main informative show of the Bosnian TV. And we have -- we have ... ERN number received from the Prosecution. It's V000-2479-1-A. So we are interested, right now, only in those six seconds.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: No objections.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: No objection. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 1D1313 receives number D383, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is admitted into evidence.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Now I would like to go back to Mr. Hogan's video, 1 -- but now it would be different time interval. So we marked it as 1D1312A.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And we'd like to show you, Mr. Hogan, from 9 minutes and 1 second, to 10 minutes and 30 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We need audio here. So if we can see it from Sanction. Can we start now, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: "Could you now please show me by standing on the spot and indicating with your hand the outer limit of the playing field which was lined with wrecked cars, to the best of your recollection, on the 1st of June, 1993. "Once again, could you please stand on the -- on the spot and indicate with your hand as you stand on the spot. "I will now draw a line along this plain with yellow spray paint. "Could you now please show me by standing on the spot where, to the best of your ..."

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We would ask for this video to be entered into evidence, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I don't have an objection to the entirety of this -- these questions and answers coming in, but I do wonder why we're -- I guess I object to it be sectioned off like this so we can't hear the entirety of what the witness is being asked to point out.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic, any problem in tendering the whole of the section of the video.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Not at all.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Then a number will be reserved. The parties will agree on what is needed and then that will be uploaded in the way needed. Madam Registrar, the number?

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The number reserved would be D384, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Please proceed, Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Thank you. [Interpretation] Let us now see a photograph, which is actually a still from this video-clip. It is an exhibit, D175 MFI, I believe.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Mr. Hogan, do you see soccer goals in this photograph that are about 3 metres wide on this upper surface; that is, on the pitch.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I do see soccer nets, goals, on the upper pitch. I -- I would agree, are approximately 3 metres wide.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [In English] Can you just circle them so we can have this in the evidence.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Now I'm --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: That's one and one is on the left-hand side?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I'm just wondering if what I'm looking at is a swing set rather than a soccer goal. But it would be at this end, so ...

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Can we have this marked picture introduced into evidence, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. The witness marked it, but do you have any recollection on whether there was a goal post there or -- because --

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Your Honour, I don't independently recall, but it would be in the right location and it does appear to be -- some sort of a goal post at the other end, so --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yeah, but that's conclusion. You say you marked what Mr. Lukic asked you to mark.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Colour is different. Shape seems to be different. But nevertheless -- heighth may also be different. We do not know exactly yet. But is it the position by the Defence, Mr. Lukic, that this second item to the left marked by the witness is similar in form, colour, and, therefore, should be a goal post?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: It's different colour, definitely. The right one is white and the left one is red and blue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: But it's still your position that it's a goal post, despite that. Is that the position of the Defence?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, yes, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Okay. Then the witness marked what the Defence claims to be a goal post. Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document D175 MFI as marked by the witness receives number D385, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is admitted into evidence. Now, D175, Mr. Lukic, was MFI'd at the time because it would be used with another witness. Do you want this to be separately or would you like to vacate D175?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We can vacate D175 [overlapping speakers]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: D175 is vacated. We had, by the way, a similar thing, I think, with D126. But let's first listen to Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We have a problem. One marking is gone, so can we ask witness to mark again, please. I apologise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Both locations?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Both locations, the goal post at the right, and the brownish structure, claimed by Defence to be a goal post, to the left.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, you caught it? It's lost again? Then I suggest the following: We re-instate D175 and we say that the witness, when he marked, which, for technical reasons would not be reserved, he marked a white goal post at the very right end of -- of the pitch, white in colour, and just before a whitish part of the building. Then he further marked to the very left of the photograph, again approximately at the middle of the photograph, a structure which seems to be an iron structure, brownish, and, at the very, very left hand of this photograph. Then I think everything is clear. We vacate the last number of the marked photograph, and we'll continue.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE FLUEGGE
utterances.text: Can we zoom out this picture a bit. Perhaps it is a -- blurred because of the zooming in, the left goal. Not possible to zoom out further? Okay. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, then the last number we assigned for the marked photograph is now vacated.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: To put everything straight on the record: 1D000705, which was ...

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: 65 ter number or the document ID 1D00705, which was MFI'd on the 5th of February of this year and received number D175, is now admitted into evidence. And the marked version of this same photograph is now -- which received number D385, that number is now vacated, and the marking is read out into the transcript earlier by me today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: By admitted D175, it goes almost without saying that the MFI status is removed. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Finally. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Hogan, the Trial Chamber did its utmost for us to overcome the technical problems. I just have another question about this. Did you check the pitch above the parking lot in the context of the explosions of mortar shells?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No, I didn't.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I am left with only one more topic. I think we'll deal with -- deal with it fast. And it has to do with the humanitarian aid. I'm talking about incident G7. The civilians at the Dobrinja neighbourhood were targeted with a salvo of three mortar shells of 120-millimetre calibre. It isn't said where they exploded exactly. You talked to witness Fata Spahic, who was one of the persons injured in that incident which occurred on the 4th of February, 1994. Let us take a brief look at a clip from your video.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 1D1312B. We need an interval from your video, V000-3471A, from 1 minute -- I'm sorry, 1 hour, 40 minutes, 16 seconds through 1 hour, 41 minutes, 54 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: "Could you please step to the one side. I'm going to mark this spot with yellow paint with the figure X and a number 2 beside it. "Could you please show me by standing at the spot where, to the best of your recollection, the second shell exploded on the 4th of February, 1994."

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Mr. Hogan, is it true that in the Karadzic case you said that Fata Spahic was not able to register the point of explosion and the place that she marked as the place of the second explosion is not the place where the shell exploded that day?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm not sure if I said exactly that. But I do agree that this location that she showed in the video is not the actual location where the second shell exploded.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you. Very briefly. Let us look at an exhibit that has probably received a D number, but I have it as 65 ter 9999. It's a report. Now I see only one document here, and I meant to ask for page 23 in B/C/S and page 5 in English.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: I don't think that there is a B/C/S document. There are only three English documents uploaded.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: That's the page I need.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Okay. I apologise. It's the mixed English and --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: So in English, we need page 5. That's it, yes.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We don't have separate English and B/C/S. It's one document in three parts --

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: -- uploaded.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I accept that. But we see on the screen what we need. We need -- we see the picture, and we see English text if somebody wants to follow what's written under. And in English, it's under number 8245, four last digits.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In this document, we see a red arrow marking on the photograph that one of the shells landed close to this lamp-post and this was confirmed by Witness Sabljica. He confirmed that a shell exploded there. And now -- but, first, please, try to remember this place that is marked as the location of the explosion. Now we would need again your video, V000-3497-1-A. The time is 1 hour, 39 minutes, 59 minutes -- seconds, up to 1 hour, 41 minutes, 3 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And if we can be assisted by Ms. Stewart again. We can start, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yeah -- you can stop. I thought -- you can stop. And can we go back and start from the beginning, please. So 1 hour, 39 minutes, 59 seconds. Yes. And only to go for four seconds. 1 hour, 40 minutes, 3 seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: You can stop. You can stop.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Do you remember that when you were there, you saw a damaged angle in the pavement precisely near the lamp-post?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: We can go a bit further, if you want. Just a couple of more seconds.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: You can stop.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, I see that.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: In the course of your investigation, did you note that on that day, three - not two - shells landed here on that day?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Three in the area. Not on this paved surface that we're looking at, but three in this area, yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did you investigate precisely this missing part of the pavement as one of the sites of explosion?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No. I -- I never concentrated on the actual crater analysis. That was done at the time by the local investigators and by UNPROFOR.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we just see one more photograph. That is 1D -- [In English] Sorry, we would offer this part of video into evidence as well. And it's on that -- the same DVD we handed in -- in -- to the Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I have the same objection that I had to the previous video where we were getting tiny bits and snips out of it. I just think it's out of context, and, in fairness, the whole video should come in of all of the questions that were asked in her indications.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I again invite the parties to sit together. You are complaining about selections made. Now if there are other parts you deem to be relevant, they could be added, but whether we should look at all of it, if both parties find irrelevance in it is, of course, a different matter. The parties are supposed to sit together and make the final selection of this video for which the following number would be reserved. Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The reserved number would be D385, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is -- no. That's just the reserved number. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: And I just want to show you one more photograph, and it's 1D1303. [Interpretation] When you were on the spot, this is a photograph that shows the site of the explosion of one of the shells in that incident. Did you investigate it?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Again, I -- I didn't investigate the actual explosion site, but I did speak to witnesses and -- and was shown this location on video in 2001.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did Mrs. Spahic show to you that at this place, at the time of the explosion, there was a door?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't think that was Mrs. Spahic. I think that was a separate witness that -- that told me that there was a door here.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Well, one of the witnesses did show you there had been a door there.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Did you determine that there was, indeed, a door there?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Mr. Hogan, thank you for answering my questions. This was all on our part today. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: You're welcome.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Only I would like to tender this photograph.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: The photograph would receive number ...

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 1D1303 receives number D386, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: D386 is admitted into evidence. Before I give you an opportunity to re-examine the witness, could I deal with a matter briefly. And -- but I need a few more seconds to prepare it. My computer is a bit slow. That explains ... Yes. Could I draw the attention of the parties to the following: Could we first briefly have a look at P3, e-court page 9. It's about Scheduled Incident F1. Could I draw the attention of the parties -- since apparently the cemetery plays an important role in the dispute between the parties, could I invite the parties now to closely look at where the cemetery is situated; that is, if you look at a street which goes through the letter K of Sirokaca, then continues in a kind of a cross and then continues as Mehmeda Mujezinovica, and that the cemetery is both to the left and to the right of this road. Could I now have a look at D376. It may be clear that on the map used here by the Defence the cemetery, as indicated by a green area with crescents, is different from what we see on the other map. And since the parties apparently want to draw conclusions from what you see of a cemetery, this might be relevant. Therefore, it may also be relevant to know exactly what the outlines were of this cemetery in the early 1990s or when Mr. Hogan took his photographs. And in order to make it not further complicated, if you will look at Google Earth, you'll see that, at this moment, the cemetery even extends beyond what is shown on P3. I draw the attention of the parties to it not to loosely draw conclusions. And I have one final question for you, Mr. Hogan. The famous red dot, is that to the right, as you put it, of the street Zagrici or is it to the left of it?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: It's to the left of it, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: It's to the left of it. Then I see it better. And we see it on the F1 location in P3, page 9, as well. I wanted to draw the attention the parties to not only apparently trees grow, but cemeteries grow as well. Ms. Hochhauser, any questions in re-examination?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Thank you. Can we please see 65 ter 19792 at page 12 on the monitor.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And, Investigator Hogan, as that is coming up, some questions were asked yesterday beginning at page -- transcript page 17697 which the Defence refuted the accuracy of the reading from way-point 5 on that satellite image that's in evidence as P2380. Now I'm showing you now on the monitor page 12 of 65 ter 1972 [sic] and that's a photograph that bears the ERN number 06197147. And we see here, I believe you told us earlier it's your car and there's some instruments on the hood of it. Can you tell us, is that a picture -- well, tell us what that is a picture of.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I believe that's way-point 2, not way-point 5. That's in the -- the farm-stead area where we saw the meadow. And ...

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Sorry, if I could stop you for just one second. And let me just check my number. And I see, actually, according to the index, you're correct, and I've pulled up the wrong picture, so I'm going to move on and come back when I've located the right picture. Let's see ... Can we turn for a moment, please, to the F1 shooting of Anisa Pita and look at D377 on the screen, please. Okay. Now can you tell us looking at this photograph from what vantage point or location this picture was taken. Are you able to orient us?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Is this the -- the camera was between the two houses, between the fences of the houses. So it would be approximately, I'd say 2 -- 2 to 3 metres south of where young Anisa was standing when she was shot. And the view-point is towards the south-west.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And I believe you identified that as the cemetery that we were actually just talking about in prior testimony. From the view-point of where Anisa Pita was located when she was shot, are you able to see this same view or any portion of the cemetery?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Now, have you had the opportunity to go up onto the baba rock area that is the alleged shooting location -- original of fire for this incident, F1?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And did you make any observations about whether there were any Serb military emplacements dug up on that rock?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, there were.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: So at this point, Your Honours, if I could, I'd like to add to the Prosecution's 65 ter exhibit list a still from a video that has the 65 ter number 22509. We've provisionally assigned the still 65 ter 30326, pending Your Honours' approval to have that still added.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: No objection against addition to the 65 ter list. Leave is granted.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And if we could see that, please, on the monitor now. That's 65 ter 30326, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And, Mr. Hogan, if you recognise this, can you tell us, please, what it is.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is the -- a stretch of the Pale road. The rocky -- the highest point of ground that we see, the rocky point and the little hump of rock beside it, is what's known as Baba Stijena, grandmother rock. And towards the camera, that emplacement, is a fortification and a shelter along the Pale road built right along the edge of the guardrail, and just on the other side of this emplacement the ground drops very steeply -- excuse me, steeply down to the city, to the Sirokaca area.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Are we looking east or west with the camera?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Your Honour, we're looking east.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And just for clarity, this is -- this was in Serb-held territory during the conflict and specifically at the time when Anisa Pita was shot; is that right?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Just for my orientation, therefore, the city and Sirokaca that is all to the left of this road in this direction.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes, thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I would like to tender this photograph, please.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, the number would be ...

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 30326 receives number P2429, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And is admitted into evidence. We are at the time of a break, Ms. Hochhauser. Could you give us an estimate as to how much more time you would need?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Your Honour, I don't think it would be more than ten to 15 minutes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Ten to 15 minutes. And that will leave sufficient time if there are any further questions. We'll first ask the usher to escort Mr. Hogan out of the courtroom.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We take a break, and we resume at 25 minutes to 2.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: While the witness is escorted into the courtroom, Mr. Lukic, the -- the -- the photograph which was already marked in another case. I think it was MFI'd under the number D126. It was now further marked by this witness. He marked the cemetery on it. What would you like to do with D126? And also is there any plan to tender part of the testimony which was -- which accompanies the earlier marking on the photographs and about which the witness told us a few things?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: If you'd just think about it. Meanwhile, Ms. Hochhauser, I hope I did not confuse you, but ...

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I hope so too, Judge.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I would like to return to the -- the --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Could Mr. Mladic speak at low volume level. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I'd like to turn back to the question that I started out with on the re-direct examination which was if we could have 65 ter 19792 at page 12 again on the monitor.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And I had actually drawn up the correct photograph that I wanted to show you, but I misspoke about which way-point the Defence had contested in their cross-examination. And it was indeed way-point 2 which you identified in that photograph. So if you could tell us, please, specifically what we're looking at in this photograph.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the road to that farm-stead in that village Studenkovici. My vehicle. The camera is facing east. On the hood of the car is a map. The satellite image which has been entered into evidence in this trial. The GPS unit, and I believe my mobile phone.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Okay. And is that the location where those instruments are and where your car is parked from where you took the -- the GPS reading for way-point 2?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Well, yes, standing right in front of the bumper of that car, yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I would tender this exhibit, although I believe Mr. Lukic and I are supposed to go through these 110 photos and decide which we will agree to tender together, so I supposed that could wait.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: This will be one of those.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. We'll wait for that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I'm just bit lost. Will the series of photos be tendered in one -- under one number or ...

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Your Honour, we can do it however the Court would like us to do it. The -- there is a selection of those photographs already in evidence as Exhibit P2382. However, the additional ones that have been used and subsequently in cross-examination and now I don't believe we've tendered individually under the idea that we would tender a second set from the 110 after consultation.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: And this would then be among the photographs in the second set.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Yes. And I read it into the record before but for clarity it bears the number ERN 06197147.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you for that. Please proceed.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I'd like to turn now to incident F12.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And today at temporary transcript pages 20 to 21, Mr. Lukic asked you if you were aware that Mr. van der Weijden objected to your GPS co-ordinates for this incident and read to you from his testimony. Do you recall that line of questioning?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I do recall that.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: If we could please have P1130 on the monitor which is Mr. van der Weijden's report and that's at page -- I'd like page 52 of the English and 64.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document is under seal.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: The document is under seal. This particular page, however, I think can be broadcast. It doesn't have any protected information on it.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: In both languages.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Correct. So it's page 52 of the English and 64 of the B/C/S.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Now, as that is coming up on to the monitor, Mr. Hogan, I'm going to read to you a portion of Mr. van der Weijden's testimony, a question and answer, about the diagram that we're about to see on that screen, and that testimony is from 19 January 2013 at transcript lines 648 -- at transcript page 6481, beginning at line 24. It says: "Q. So the lay-out the first diagram titled 'lay-out' of the incident site is the blue circle marking the location of the victim. It's slightly more toward where the GPS co-ordinates that you considered based on the mother's interview with Barry Hogan; is that right? "A. The GPS co-ordinates were given to me by the OTP and are the same as the location where the investigator had the interview, so that would -- that is it correct. And that circle is more in that position." And that refers -- that question and answer refers to the first -- to the -- to the diagram on the top of this page, lay-out of the incident site. And can you see the blue circle there indicating the GPS --

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: -- co-ordinates that you had given him?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Now, I would like to draw your attention to the second photo on that page which puts the blue circle indicating the incident site off of the sidewalk and into the zebra crossing. And this is the question, having looked at that: I'm not asking you to tell us your opinion about the correct location of this incident, but are you aware that others who have looked at this incident have considered, based on other evidence, that Mrs. Sokolovic brought you to a spot further onto the sidewalk rather than in the -- as opposed to in the zebra crossing than the incident took place.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm sorry, but I -- is that a question for me?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Yeah, I'm just -- I'm just asking you not to tell us your opinion of which one is accurate, but are aware that -- that there is some difference of opinion as to whether Mrs. Sokolovic took you to the right location. But it's not a -- it's not a debate over whether the GPS co-ordinates are correct but whether she brought you to the correct location.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Oh I understand now. Yes, I am aware of the debate, and as I explained during my direct examination, sometimes the witnesses were not sure. Or, I did not coach them, I did not practice them, I did not provide their statements to them, I did not give them any photographs or show them any videos.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And had -- have you yourself had the opportunity to stand both in the place where Mrs. Sokolovic took you as we saw on the video and also to this -- this place within the zebra crossing that's indicated on the second photograph that we're looking at here, and can you tell us how that affects the line of sight up to the Metalka building?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, there is a line of sight from both locations. Obviously from the zebra crossing more of the Metalka building is -- is visible from the zebra crossing.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Now, I'm going ask, please, Ms. Stewart to play for us a portion of 65 ter 10275 of which we have assigned the 65 ter number 10275D. It has to be played from Quick Time. And this is the 360-degree picture for the incident G4. And that is the -- the 1 June 1993 firing at the soccer game that we were discussing in cross-examination.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Is this -- was this 360-degree photograph taken in a similar -- with a similar methodology to what you described to us on direct examination?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And if can you remind us again when you -- the location of the camera corresponded with what?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this case, this -- it corresponded with one of the shell impact craters which had been pointed out to us which happened to be underneath this car in the very near foreground and the tripod was set upon the hood of the car.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Okay. And if I could ask Ms. Stewart, please, to slowly take us around this photograph, and for you to please narrate to us what it is that we're seeing, and if you need her to stop so you can explain something, just please ask her to do so.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: To start, we're facing back towards the city. So straight ahead is Alipasino Polje and the PTT building area, so we're looking north. As we rotate towards the east, the rising land is Mojmilo hill. And now we're facing almost directly east. And we'll continue to rotate towards the south-east and as land falls just behind the corner of that -- if we could just pause there. Just behind the corner of the apartment building is the front line area, and there's a VRS barracks just down at the bottom of Mojmilo hill, in that area. And if we can continue. Now moving towards the south. And just to the right as we rotate, and if we could stop there. Now we're facing almost due south and that is the location where Mr. Faslic was filmed showing the goal posts from the soccer game.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: When you say "that is," can you describe more specifically on the photo of the area you're just trying to describe.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, sorry. The memorial that we can see with a -- what appears to be a white stone marker with a semi-circle of red post a small posts around it at the edge of the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: If I could ask Ms. Stewart to please zoom in on that area. Just a little to the right. More if it's possible.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And what we see here is that the memorial and it looks like it's surrounded by small red objects? I can't tell what they are.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that's the memorial to the victims of the shelling incident and that's where we saw Mr. Faslic in the previous video. And I should point out that the location from which this 360 is being shown is what was indicated to us as the second shell crater. The first one is further to the left or towards the east in this 360.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And is -- is the location -- the location of the actual memorial does that mark anything specific?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Just the location of one of the goal posts. If we could zoom out a little bit perhaps. And just to the left a little bit -- I'm sorry, to the -- yes, to the left. And underneath one of these, I'm not sure if it's the white vehicle or the grey vehicle that we're seeing in the middle of the photograph, but the first shell impact crater is underneath one of those vehicles. And -- yes. Okay. If we could continue to the right again and all the way around. We're now looking rotating to the west and the south-west. And if we could just stop there for a minute. I'm just, for my own interest, wondering about that goal post that we marked from the other place and we can see it behind the --

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I was going to ask -- direct to the same. If we can zoom in, please, on this end of the -- of the photograph showing the -- the sort of -- what we said -- what we distinguished before was the red in colour or brown in colour as opposed to the white.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: And it's right along the left edge of the photograph, behind that light-post, and looks like it's just not in very good shape, that goal post.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And would -- do you agree that what we're able to see on this 360 if the Chamber were to consider it at some point outside of a courtroom setting and zoom in on this area is also what is depicted and what was discussed in D175? We can see it with a little more clarity on the 360?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, agree, yes.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Just so we see the whole thing, can we please complete the circle and then I'll tender this exhibit.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: And there we can see the white goal-posts at the opposite end that we saw before. And now the -- the view-point is towards the west and we're almost completely around to the north again. And we're back at the starting location.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Your Honours, I would tender this 65 ter 10275D.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, the number would be ...

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Document 10275D receives number P2430, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: A DVD will be provided. I hadn't prepared one in advance since it had come up on re-direct.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: We were -- you were asked -- if I can turn to incident G7 for a moment. And that is February 1994 incident in Dobrinja. And you were asked about a videotape that you prepared with a witness and some testimony that you gave in the Karadzic case about the witness going to the wrong spot. Do you recall that line of question and answer?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I do.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Can you tell us what, if any, kind of preparations were done with her before going to that site?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Very few preparations. We made arrangements to meet at the location, and I told her that we did not want her to speak on the video but I told her what questions I would ask. I said, Do not demonstrate them to me now, but here are the questions I will ask you to do -- to demonstrate once we start the video. So there was no rehearsal. There was no preparation, very little.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Do you have any awareness of when the last time she may have been at that site was?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't think that she had gone back there since the shelling incident -- she didn't live in the area. She came from the other side of the Mojmilo hill and she only came there because the -- I'm straying. I don't think that she had been there since the shelling incident.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: If we could look for a moment, please, at Exhibit P3, at page 4. And -- in e-court.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: As it's coming up on the screen, Mr. Hogan, you've been asked a number of questions about various confrontation lines. I'm just going to ask you to take a look at page 4 of Exhibit P3 and tell us whether it corresponds with what you know about the confrontation lines in the Sarajevo area in 1992.

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, in general terms. Of course, in 1992, there were some military actions on Zuc hill, which caused that line to move. But the rest of the city was pretty stable, as far as the front lines were concerned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MOLOTO
utterances.text: We have no exhibits on the Bench.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: There it is.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: That was my -- the only question I wanted to ask about that page.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: And, Your Honours, with the exception of tendering Exhibits 2403 and 2404, which were marked for identification pending cross-examination, of which I believe there was none on those two exhibits, my -- my redirect examination is concluded. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Let me just see. You said you ... yes. You still want to tender 2403 and 2404. Any objections? No objections. Madam Registrar. Numbers are known. Yes, they were marked for identification. Therefore, P2403 and P2404 are admitted into evidence. Mr. Lukic, any need for re-examination of the witness?

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I have just one question.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Hogan, my learned friend asked you about D377, when Anisa Pita was wounded, whether the cemetery was visible or not. You told us that trees were planted after the incident. If it weren't for the trees, would you be able to see the cemetery? Is there any -- anything to block the line of sight toward -- between the injury site and the Muslim cemetery, such as a house or any other structure?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I'm going to object to this question, only in terms of the lack of precision. I think the witness told us, referring to Exhibit D513, that that specific circled tree had been planted. And so I don't think it's a -- it's correct statement.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Let's see D377.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: You were asked based on that picture.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: It's -- it's seems that we are now -- I -- did I see you're referring to the other picture taken from the spot where the child was hit?

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: Well, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: With the markings on it. This is the Defence one.

utterances.speaker: MS. HOCHHAUSER
utterances.text: I just am saying that I believe that the testimony referring to trees being planted referred to that other picture which is also a Defence exhibit, 513. And so I just wanted that to be clear, that -- I don't believe that there was talk of trees being planted in regard to this view.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Are the trees of which you said that were planted subsequently, and I'm referring to photograph D377, are those trees visible here in this photograph?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: I'm not sure. I would have to compare them to the -- this view to the 360-degree photograph that -- that we looked at earlier, which -- which can -- which was filmed at the site where the little girl was standing. So I'm not sure if this leafy tree in the -- in the -- on the right-hand side is the same one or not.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you know what kind of tree it was of which they said to you that it had -- it was planted subsequently?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Do you know when this cemetery that we can see here was set -- was laid out?

utterances.speaker: BARRY HOGAN [Resumed]
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, this is all I had.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: No further questions. Then since the Chamber has no further questions for you either, Mr. Hogan, I'd like to thank you very much for appearing in this courtroom and for having answered all the questions that were put to you, put to you by the party, put to you by the Bench, and you are excused.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: You may follow the usher.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Mr. Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Yes, if I may, Your Honour. You asked me at our temporary transcript on page 66, line 11, about D126.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: When I opened it, it's something completely different. It is in connection with the school for blind.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. I -- I do agree that it's a bit different. I might not have fully understood it. But I thought that it was MFI'd at an earlier stage without any -- but it may well be that it was just the school for the blind photograph. And let me have a look at it so that I'm not ...

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: I think in this picture we only have direction where school of blind is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, but now it was quite a while ago, I think, that this one was also marked for identification to be tendered at a later stage. And I wondered whether it would be with this witness or ...

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: Obviously not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Obviously not.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: I have to go back to the -- I have to go back to the transcript. That must be the transcript of the 11th of January of this year, where the Defence has tendered it at that time, but also said we would not rely on the markings of the locations as we find them here, pending a clarification through another witness. So apparently we thought that it might be through this witness and can even be that you have announced that it would be through this witness, but if not, then we just leave it as it is. This document is MFI'd only.

utterances.speaker: MR. LUKIC
utterances.text: When I said it, I probably meant our expert witnesses, ballistic expert witnesses.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: That could be. I don't have a recollection of that. Then this matter being clarified, Mr. Groome.

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Your Honours, can I please deal with a brief matter in private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: We move into private session.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: We're in open session, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ORIE
utterances.text: Thank you, Madam Registrar. If there's nothing else to be dealt with, we'll adjourn, and we'll resume not tomorrow, but Thursday, the 3rd of October, at 9.30 in the morning in this same courtroom, I.
